title: right-git per-repo manifest (.rightgit.json)
description: Declares which right-git lanes a public repo installs and how templates should be parameterized. Hand-validated by manifest.mjs — this file documents the contract, it is not fed to a JSON Schema validator at runtime.

defaultBranch.description: Branch the ci, qualification and package-smoke push triggers and the rust-hybrid release-candidate admission use. Default main.

checkout.description: Opt-in options for every actions/checkout step. longPaths renders a Windows-only step before each checkout running `git config --system core.longpaths true` (fixes 'Filename too long' on windows runners). sparse renders `sparse-checkout` (cone mode) with these directories into each checkout of the repository itself. Unset renders nothing.

workflows.description: Named workflows rendered by code. kind custom: one build job with triggers (push/pull_request with paths, workflow_dispatch), steps, toolchain pins, a named artifact, per-workflow sparse checkout and concurrency. kind swift-host: swift test on Windows and macOS hosts for chosen packages. kind dispatch-matrix: workflow_dispatch inputs, a plan job emitting a matrix, per-item jobs and a collect job. Every action is pinned to a commit SHA, permissions are contents: read, and no step may read secrets. Validated in full by validateManifest (workflows.mjs).

swift.description: Opt-in read access to private Swift package mirrors. Renders a configure step before the first build or test step and an always-run cleanup step after the last one, in the ci job, the qualification job, the release-candidate candidate job, the regenerate job and the parallel dev-artifact-mac job. Needs at least one of the lanes ci, qualification, release-candidate, regenerate or swift-check. swift.check configures native iOS XCTest in the swift-check lane. Unset renders nothing.

host.description: Bare host name, for example github.com. Unique within the list.

secret.description: GitHub Actions secret name holding a fine-grained token with contents:read on the mirror. Provisioned by the repository owner.

keySuffix.description: Appended to the Swatinem/rust-cache key as <lane>-<keySuffix>. rust-cache never re-saves on an exact key hit; change the suffix to rotate the cache.

shards.description: rust-hybrid ci only. The gate runs once per shard per matrix.os runner as `bash <path> --group <id>` on one shared Rust cache; a ci-summary job passes only when every leg passed. Requires devArtifact.parallel when devArtifact is set.

quick.description: Needs shards. A `quick` job runs `bash <path> --quick` (the fast deterministic checks) before any shard starts.

qaEvidencePath.description: rust-hybrid only. Safe relative path under $RUNNER_TEMP where the gate writes QA evidence; rendered as ${{ runner.temp }}/<path> and uploaded with if: always().

qaEvidenceRetentionDays.description: rust-hybrid only, requires qaEvidencePath. Artifact retention in days.

ciAllOs.description: rust-hybrid only. When true, the ci job runs the gate on every matrix.os runner in declared order (fail-fast: false). When false or unset, the ci job uses one runner (preferring the first windows-* entry, else the first matrix.os entry).

ciIncremental.description: rust-hybrid only. When true, the ci job uses Swatinem/rust-cache with cache-workspace-crates, CARGO_INCREMENTAL=1, and caches Xcode DerivedData on macOS legs.

regenerate.description: Manual-only lane: runs `script`, checks the result, and opens a pull request from a right-git/regenerate-<run> branch. Requires lane 'regenerate'. Never writes to the default branch.

signExisting.description: rust-hybrid only. Manual-only lane 'sign-existing': verifies an already-qualified artifact of another run of this repository (run id, artifact id or name, source sha) through the GitHub API and signs it per file with right-release sign-dev-artifact in the protected signing environment. Never builds. Requires lane 'sign-existing' and a macOS runner in matrix.os.

macSignManifest.description: Repository-relative sign manifest JSON (per-file fixed codesign identifiers, paths relative to the extracted artifact).

macPayloadMetadata.description: Payload metadata JSON inside the artifact, relative to the extracted artifact root.

macPayloadMetadataSource.description: Optional repository-relative path of a generated payload metadata file (for example dist/dev-macos/payload.json). When set, the unsigned dev packaging step zips the .app (wrapper layout kept) plus this file at the inner-zip root, named by macPayloadMetadata (a bare file name); the step fails if the file is missing. Needs devArtifact.mac 'sign', 'notarize' or 'unsigned'.

environment.description: Protected GitHub environment holding the Developer ID secrets. Defaults to the candidate.releaseChain signing environment, else 'release'.

concurrency.description: Requires lane 'ci'. Sets the ci workflow's concurrency: one CI run in progress per repository unless mainPushes is 'queue' with a recorded reason.

mainPushes.description: 'cancel' (default) renders the supersede job: a newer push to the default branch cancels an older run that only just started or is failing, and waits for one that is nearly done. 'queue' lets default-branch pushes run to completion, renders no supersede job and requires 'reason'; PR runs still cancel superseded runs.

graceFraction.description: Not with mainPushes 'queue'. An older default-branch run is cancelled by a newer push while its elapsed time is under this fraction of the median duration of the last medianWindow successful runs (or when any of its jobs has failed). Past it, the run is left to finish and the new run waits.

medianWindow.description: Not with mainPushes 'queue'. How many recent successful push runs of the workflow the median duration is taken over. With fewer than 3 such runs nothing is cancelled for being young; only runs that never started and runs with a failed job are.

reason.description: Required, non-empty, single line, when mainPushes is 'queue': why default-branch pushes must not cancel each other. Rendered as a YAML comment above the ci workflow's concurrency block.

devArtifact.description: rust-hybrid only. Dev builds on push to the default branch (never PRs). mac 'sign' Developer ID-signs (no notarization) in a separate job using the release environment; windows 'unsigned' uploads built files as-is.

parallel.description: When true, each platform builds and stages the dev app in its own dev-artifact-<platform> job beside the QA gate job, instead of after the gate in the ci job. Requires buildScript.

buildScript.description: Package script that compiles the dev app. Required when parallel is true; rejected otherwise.

macAppPath.description: Repository-relative path of the built .app (required when mac is 'sign').

macEntitlements.description: Optional repository-relative entitlements plist for codesign.

macSignManifest.description: Optional repository-relative sign manifest JSON (right-release sign-dev-artifact: per-file fixed codesign identifier, paths relative to the extracted archive). With mac 'sign', replaces codesign --deep on the .app. Requires macPayloadMetadata; not combinable with macEntitlements or mac 'notarize'.

macPayloadMetadata.description: Path of the payload metadata JSON (recorded hashes) inside the staged archive, relative to the extracted archive root. Required with macSignManifest.

windowsGlob.description: Repository-relative glob of built files to upload (required when windows is 'unsigned').

admissionScript.description: Runs in the unconditional `admission` job (workflow_dispatch envelope validation). Required for every release-candidate lane, signed or not.

stageSummaryScript.description: Runs (init/finalize) in the `candidate` job and, when configured, the windows-sign/macos-sign jobs. Required for every release-candidate lane, signed or not.

devQualification.description: Optional `dev-qualification` job (Orthic-Labs/rightkit#107): builds the dev build (QA surface on) from the admitted revision and runs the app's in-app journeys against it. Gates windows-sign and macos-sign. The sealed candidate stays QA-free. Unset renders nothing.

buildScript.description: Package script that builds the dev build. Must differ from candidate.buildScript.

journeyScript.description: Package script that runs the in-app journeys against the dev build.

evidenceVerificationScript.description: Runs in the `publish` job before the publish step, verifying the aggregated same-run signed/qualification evidence.
